name: qfd_cb16c_es257

Outline 21.6 x 145.8 (141.48 um of pins, <= 146 um of bus); recipe 4 flop-first, hold_budget die; same recipe as es182/es199.

job.purpose: CB16c-COLL2-SR: R-face edge slice qfd_coll_eslice257 (ALT regional split of the COLLIO faces)
